description.value: Gyu-Kaku is a Japanese yakiniku (BBQ) restaurant where guests grill their own meats over a charcoal flame built into each table, a hands-on dining format originating in Japan. This Richmond location is part of an international chain with a broad menu including à la carte, course, kids, and vegetarian options. It sits in a commercial mall on Alderbridge Way in central Richmond.

address.value: 7971 Alderbridge Way, Unit 120, Richmond, BC V6X 2A4
